deployments_detail.use: Deep learning-based sensor sorting for waste and metal recycling material recovery
deployments_detail.value: first to introduce deep learning AI to recycling

deployments_detail.use: GAINnext deep learning sorting technology for improved material purity

GAINnext deep-learning add-on for sensor-based waste and metal recycling sorters; integrated neural-network software identifies hard-to-classify objects (e.g. food-grade plastics, silicone cartridges) on live AUTOSORT lines, reducing manual sorting [TOMRA in-house deep learning (GAINnext)]
deployments_detail.value: food-grade PET trays sorted at 95%+ purity

deployments_detail.use: GAINnext deep-learning application for aluminum recycling: separates low-alloy cast from wrought fractions and identifies used beverage cans (UBC) in mixed metal streams, launched in North America and adapted for Europe [TOMRA in-house deep learning (GAINnext)]
deployments_detail.value: 33x throughput vs manual sorting at 98%+ purity for UBC aluminum

deployments_detail.use: TOMRA Mining CONTAIN deep-learning ore classification: convolutional neural networks analyze X-ray imagery in real time to detect inclusion-type ores (tungsten, nickel, tin); field-deployed and operational [TOMRA Mining in-house deep learning (CONTAIN)]
deployments_detail.value: 8% increase in plant throughput and 33% reduction in ore mineral losses (Wolfram Bergbau, Austria trial)

deployments_detail.use: TOMRA Mining OBTAIN AI ore-sorting software: neural network classifies individual particles at single-particle precision in high-throughput XRT sorting, available on new XRT sorters and as an upgrade package for installed machines [TOMRA Mining in-house deep learning (OBTAIN)]

TOMRA Food LUCAi contextual deep-learning models for post-harvest fruit sorting/grading (blueberries, apples, cherries, citrus); world-first fresh-fruit deep learning model deployed at customers such as Decai Agriculture (China) for soft/defect blueberry removal [TOMRA Food in-house deep learning (LUCAi)]

TOMRA 4C AI-powered optical chute sorter for nuts and IQF (individually quick frozen) foods, combining LUCAi deep learning and trainable machine learning to detect defects and foreign materials [TOMRA Food in-house deep learning (LUCAi)]
deployments_detail.value: >97% defect/foreign-material detection with <1% false reject rate; cleaning time reduced 65%

deployments_detail.use: PolyPerception AI-native platform / AI agent for recycling plant operators: natural-language 'chat with plant data', similarity search for contaminated items, brand/text search and custom quality reporting; TOMRA raised its PolyPerception stake to 51% majority [PolyPerception (TOMRA majority-owned)]

Predictive-maintenance 'Smart Service' concept for reverse vending machines: sensor data from 82,000+ RVMs analyzed with Vertex AI (plus BigQuery, Firestore, Pub/Sub) to predict component failures and increase uptime [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Firestore, Pub/Sub)]
deployments_detail.value: 82,000 RVMs across 60+ markets; ~45 billion containers/yr captured (proof-of-concept stage)

deployments_detail.use: TOMRA Collection North America field-service transformation on IFS Cloud with embedded IFS.ai: Copilot for Knowledge Search (technician documentation assistant) and What-If Scenario Explorer (WISE) for real-time planning/scheduling simulation [IFS (IFS.ai, IFS Cloud)]
deployments_detail.value: first-time fix rate improved from 84% to 96-97%; ~27% operational efficiency gain
